Workout

Pick a saved workout to load it — or type a new name in the search box to save the current one under that name. Save updates the loaded workout; New starts a blank one (people, machines and branding stay). Export / Import moves a workout between phones as a text code.

Session type

Blocks

Build each block below: + Add exercise gives one exercise with its own time; + Group exercises puts several exercises on one shared time. The red dot marks an exercise or group as scored. Blocks run their items top to bottom when the trainer starts them. Added things separately? Use ⤴ on any item to group it with the one above, and ⤵ on a grouped exercise to ungroup it.
Set each block's rest in its own row below.
How a session runs: everyone is assigned to a machine automatically — every screen shows who goes where. The trainer starts each block when the floor is set. Each block runs its exercises and groups top to bottom on their own times; anything marked with the red dot is scored and banks to the leaderboard.

Waves

Athletes are grouped into waves by their order in the list (first N = wave 1, next N = wave 2 …). Every wave races the same stations below, and each athlete's clock starts when their wave is released — so the leaderboard (fastest total time) is fair across waves.

Gym machines capacity checks & auto-assignment

Gym equipment racks, bars, sleds — how many you own

EquipmentHow many
Add the kit the gym actually has. Link an exercise to it in Setup and every screen works the sharing out for you \u2014 12 athletes and 4 squat racks is three to a rack, and each of them is told which one. An exercise with no equipment gives everybody their own spot.
Build with AI
Describe the class in your own words — parts, times, rounds, rests, sharing, scoring — and the Setup fills itself for you to review and save. Unclear bits come back as questions. Dictate with your keyboard's mic or the Voice button.
🔗 Gym link connected
Your gym link connects this device to every saved workout and the live clock. It must be pasted once on each device — phone, laptop and tablet. On a device that already works, tap Copy to get the link, then paste it on the new device and tap Save.
